    YOUR LIGHTING MODEL

    Configuration

    Use the real electrical power of your prototype lamps. These values determine estimated consumption.

    This idle setting affects the demo. Live data uses brightness reported by the ESP32. Estimates omit ESP32 and sensor power unless supplied by a whole-system power meter.

    Changing demo settings starts a new demo session.
    ESP32 + WI-FI

    Connect your street

    1

    Use the same Wi-Fi networkConnect your laptop and ESP32 to the same 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

    2

    Start the included laptop serviceRun node server.mjs in the downloaded project. It displays your laptop address and a device key.

    3

    Add the Wi-Fi helper to your ESP32 sketchSet your Wi-Fi name, password, laptop address and device key. The included guide explains the two integration calls.

    4

    Open the laptop dashboardUse the local address printed by the service, then select “Use live Wi-Fi data” below.

    The online preview runs in demo mode. The included local dashboard receives real ESP32 readings over Wi-Fi without a cloud account.
